'''Stoodbeak''' is a [[Water]] type [[Tank]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Swaystroll]] at 18 stars, and evolves into [[Glideflip]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Stoodbeak has an intimidating 'don't mess with me' attitude. With a temper that terrible, almost no Tatari dares to come close. Rumor has it that [[Capywata]]'s orange is the only thing that can make Stoodbeak calm down."

Stoodbeak is a red rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
TBA

== Evolution Trial ==
Stoodbeak's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 36 stars. To evolve it into [[Glideflip]] you need to complete the following three tasks:

* Feed this Tatari to B quality.
* Play Fishing Contest (use x6000 fishing rods) or Snowboard Sprint/Marathon Party (use x6000 boards).
* In Horde Invasion, upgrade Stoodbeak to Lvl 7 or above for a total of 5 time(s).

== Trivia ==
* Original Bio: "Stoodbeak graduated Critter College and got a job as a Zobo Security Expert with full benefits."
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "Stoodbeak proudly graduated from Tatari College and landed a job as a Zobo Security Expert with full benefits."
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "When Stoodbeak loses control, a frigid breath is released that can freeze everything nearby. Almost no Tatari is willing to live close."
